records.text: Israel intentionally killed tens of thousands of Palestinian civilians in Gaza in conduct Candace Owens characterized as genocide.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: tens of thousands of innocent Palestinians have been killed. ... and that they've been intentionally targeted because they're conducting a genocide

verification.notes: By the episode date, reported deaths exceeded 60,000 and a UN-mandated commission had concluded that Israeli forces committed genocidal acts with intent; other analyses also estimated a large civilian majority. Israel disputes the genocide finding and casualty characterization, which should remain visible as a caveat, but authoritative evidence supports the statement as framed.

records.text: Jared Kushner invested in a genocide before it happened and presented plans for what would follow its completion.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He invested in a genocide before it happened, presented plans for what they would do once genocide was completed.

verification.notes: Affinity announced a large Israeli investment in September 2023 before the October 7 attack, and Kushner later publicly presented a postwar Gaza redevelopment plan. Those facts support the timing components, but no reliable source establishes that the commercial investment funded genocide or was made in anticipation of it.
